description: This file defines the LeaveLedgerEntry class and related functions for managing leave ledger entries, including validation, creation, deletion, and expiry processing within an HR system.

classes.name: LeaveLedgerEntry
classes.description: Represents a leave ledger entry with validation and cancellation logic.

methods.name: validate_leave_allocation_against_leave_application
methods.description: Checks that a leave allocation has no linked leave application.

methods.name: create_leave_ledger_entry
methods.description: Creates and optionally submits a new leave ledger entry.

methods.name: delete_ledger_entry
methods.description: Deletes a ledger entry, handling expiry and related cleanup.

methods.name: get_previous_expiry_ledger_entry
methods.description: Retrieves the expiry ledger entry associated with a given ledger entry.

methods.name: process_expired_allocation
methods.description: Processes and creates expiry entries for expired leave allocations.

methods.name: create_expiry_ledger_entry
methods.description: Creates expiry ledger entries for a list of allocations.

methods.name: get_remaining_leaves
methods.description: Calculates remaining leaves for a given allocation.

methods.name: expire_allocation
methods.description: Expires a non-carry forwarded leave allocation.

methods.name: expire_carried_forward_allocation
methods.description: Expires remaining leaves in a carried forward leave allocation.
